rationale: Price is sitting at 4.1% of today's range, just 0.41% above the session low of $14.54, with the last five 1-minute candles showing a slow grind lower on declining volume — no clear reversal signal to support a long. A short is unattractive because price is already compressed near the day's low with tight candle bodies suggesting exhaustion rather than continuation, and the broad market is strongly up (SPY +4.9%, VIXY -14.7%), creating headwind for further downside. With no structural edge in either direction and 87 minutes to forced liquidation, the risk/reward does not justify committing capital.
